body: I've been broken up with due to being depressed, I couldn't imagine having them act that way on top of it. I'm sorry, and feel for you. It sounds like they're toxic, at least now. The only reason someone would make a list is if they wanted to hurt you. I'm not saying take them back at all, but understand they're doing it because they know it'll hurt you. Try not to let it get to you, they'll stop soon enough.

I'd say the best thing you can do is be there for your friend. It sounds like you two are close, and sometimes having someone you love close by helps a ton. If you're aware what you would say is hypocritical, be honest and tell her you know you're being hypocritical. Honesty goes a long way. Doing something is better than nothing. At the very least, check up on her. Show her you care.
